labelled_by: Claude (draft, researched live via WebFetch/WebSearch 2026-09-27) -- NOT an independent human researcher; needs human review before being treated as frozen ground truth.
rules: Label only what the website states. No outside knowledge. Copy quotes exactly. If pages disagree, record both as conflicting. If the site does not say, use not_found.
review_notes: Homepage also uses the tagline 'The Agentic Cloud for Healthcare'; the longer sentence from the About page was used as the description field. HQ page lists San Francisco as the primary address plus additional offices in Delhi, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi -- only SF address used as headquarters value. No pricing numbers found anywhere on-site; the site is entirely demo/contact-sales driven ('Request a Demo' pages), so pricing.public_plans, free_trial, and revenue_model are not_found. No on-site comparison/'vs' page naming competitors was found via search. customers.industries is effectively 'healthcare' as the single vertical the whole platform addresses, restated at the segment level given the company's singular focus. B-51 (2026-09-27): customers.segments' evidence was a paraphrase, not a literal quote; re-checked live and confirmed 'Provider / Payer / Public Sector / Life Sciences' are real short nav labels on the site (under a section literally headed 'INDUSTRIES', which is why customers.industries above independently arrives at the same healthcare framing) -- evidence updated to those exact labels. Separately noticed, not fixed here: customers.industries' status is 'inferred', but that field is not on this project's INFERENCE_WHITELIST (wi/schemas/claim.py) -- the same class of labelling bug found on temenos.json/thoughtworks.json's customers.segments, flagged for a separate fix.
